summary: Closed Phase 11 (Collapse literature-search.sh's Self-Internal Repetition): this script had has_test:false, so a characterization suite (tests/test-literature-search.sh, 49 assertions over a from-scratch fixture local+global corpus) was written first and confirmed green on the unmodified script before any edit. NET-PROD -363 (-695 net on literature-search.sh plus +332 for the new lib file; manifest.json's +2-line registration excluded per Phase 9's convention). NET-TEST +384 for the new characterization suite (not required negative for this phase). Verified byte-identical: captured all 20 CLI modes' raw stdout+exit code (40 files) before and after the refactor, diff -r reported zero differences. Shellcheck clean; test-lit-pipeline.sh (a real downstream caller) green. manifest.json and the new lib/ file were dropped by git-commit-phase.sh's containment self-check (not in task 328's declared file_scope) and recovered via a labeled follow-up commit, matching Phase 10's precedent. Per the phase's own declared local tier, no redeploy/full gate battery was run (deferred to Phase 20). 9 of 20 plan phases remain, starting with Phase 12 (classify every suite and enforce the unit/integration boundary -- its own Scope Hypothesis flags that the dispatch's heavyweight-operation invocation counts and the research report's file counts must be re-derived consistently before use, since they count different things).
